paragraph1: Before I wrote a line of code, I spent a decade as a working jazz saxophonist. I performed, recorded, and taught in Chicago — not as a side project, but as a career.
paragraph2: My primary ensemble was Eastern Blok, with whom I recorded two albums. I also performed with the Goran Ivanovic Group and had the privilege of sharing stages with Robert Glasper, Kendrick Scott, Kelan Phil Cohran, and Robert 'Baabe' Irving III.
paragraph3: Music taught me how to listen, how to collaborate under pressure, and how to hold a structure together while leaving room for something unexpected. Those habits didn't disappear when I switched careers — they just found a new medium.
pressQuote: A fearlessness of spirit and a robustness of tone
